st.title: Session settings
st.liveIdle: Changes apply when it is idle.
st.liveBusy: It is working or waiting for you now. Change these when this reply ends.
st.fixedDesc: To change these, start a new chat in another folder, or fork this one. Folder access and tool mode are fixed when its first turn starts.
st.modelThisChat: Changes only this chat. Later chats keep their agent's own model.
st.modelNextTurn: Applies from this chat's next turn.
st.modelClaudeGated: Model: this chat runs on Claude Code, and its model cannot be switched from here yet.
st.modelClaudeNone: Model: this chat runs on Claude Code, and this computer lists no Claude Code models to switch to.
st.modelClaudeUnread: Model: this chat runs on Claude Code, and this computer's Claude Code models could not be read.
st.nextTurn: Applies from this chat's next turn.
st.heldClaude: Claude Code applies a change made while the chat is working when the reply ends. If that is why, Check again then.
st.modelUnknown: The model this chat uses couldn't be read.
st.notPersisted: Changed for this chat, but its record could not be saved, so the change may not last if the agent restarts.
st.defaultChanged: Changed. This computer's agent also made it {{agent}}'s default model, so later chats with {{agent}} use it too.
st.busyModel: Change the model when this reply ends.
st.modelWait: Wait until this chat's settings are read and saved.
st.busyOther: Change this when the reply ends.
st.deferred: A waiting approval kept the agent from switching. Change it when the reply ends.
st.agentsFailed: The agents on this computer couldn't be read, so the agent can't be changed here now.
st.readFailed: This chat's settings couldn't be read.
st.defaultNotSaved: Changed for this chat. This computer's agent also tried to make it {{agent}}'s default model but could not save that, so later chats with {{agent}} keep their model.
